# Where Big Fish

> Where Big Fish is a free, real-time multiplayer fishing game that runs in any modern web browser — no download or install. Cast your line, win a reel minigame, collect fish of every rarity, and climb a live leaderboard with other players fishing the same lake.

Where Big Fish is free-to-play and browser-based on desktop; no account or install is required. The core loop is: cast your line, win the reel minigame, land the fish, score points, and climb the live leaderboard where every player's total catch value is ranked in real time.

To play: enter a name and pick a character, then press Play. Walk to a lake, river, or sea shore with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold the mouse to charge power and release to cast toward the cursor. When a fish bites, the reel minigame opens — hold the mouse to lift the green catch zone and keep the moving fish inside it until the progress bar fills. Rarer and heavier fish are worth more points.

There are 16 fish species across common, uncommon, rare, and legendary tiers — from the common Minnow, Silver Carp, and Catfish to the legendary Golden Arowana and Baby Shark — plus a few quirky finds (an Old Boot, Soggy Bread, and Vicent's Wallet). Ocean species (Butterfish, Mackerel, Bluefin Tuna, Baby Shark) appear only in the East Sea, while the rest live across the lakes and river: Village Pond, Mirror Lake, Serpent Lake, Lotus Marsh, Ice Bay, Dragon Lake, and the Han River.
